item.title: Brazilians vote in presidential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Voters in Brazil headed to the polls on Sunday in a closely fought presidential runoff between incumbent left-wing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 80, and far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, 45, the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Polls opened at 8 a.m. (11:00 GMT) and close at 5 p.m.…

item.title: US evacuates Mideast outposts as Iran plot advances; Trump prepares for escalation
item.description: The State Department has ordered staffing reductions at multiple U.S. embassies in the Middle East, including in Lebanon, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar and Jordan, and placed the U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia under “ordered departure,” following a Director of National Intelligence memo warning…

item.title: Brewers rally past Rays for 5-4 win, take 2-0 World Series lead
item.description: MILWAUKEE — The Milwaukee Brewers overcame a four-run first-inning deficit for the second time this postseason, rallying past the Tampa Bay Rays 5-4 on Saturday night at American Family Field to take a 2-0 lead in the World Series.
